summary: Frontend-only regression passed for the updated ATELIER portfolio on desktop and mobile: compact modern hero typography, warm gradient, terracotta accents, pill badges, first-viewport projects, navigation, images, responsive menu, no horizontal overflow, and successful contact submission.
action_items: Previously reported /api/contact empty-string validation issue was not retested because this iteration was frontend-only.
seed_data_creation: Submitted one UI regression contact inquiry using ui-test@example.com; no existing records were modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend visual and responsive requirements passed at 1920x1080 and 390x844. Prior iteration's backend empty/whitespace contact validation defect remains unverified in this frontend-only run.
rca of the issue: No frontend defects reproduced. The prior backend issue remains that plain string contact fields may accept empty values; backend retest is required after schema validation changes.
